query: Design the hero section for our new product's marketing landing page.
expected_behavior: Identifies whether the landing page primarily serves brand expression, product work, or both, using the supplied context
Recommends a distinctive direction and explains how typography, color, and layout serve the brand and page task
Questions familiar defaults only when they are unsupported by the supplied brand or task, without treating a font, gradient, or card grid as automatically wrong
Gives a concrete way to assess whether the page communicates its offer and next step to its intended audience
